project_type: TypeScript monorepo (4 independent packages: frontend React 19 + Vite 8, backend AWS Lambda ESM, infra AWS CDK, e2e Playwright). No workspace-level package manager; run npm install inside each package.
build_system: Per-package npm. Backend/frontend/infra each have their own package.json. Backend is ESM ('type':'module') — ALL relative imports MUST use .js extension even for .ts source. Infra Lambdas are bundled by esbuild via NodejsFunction from backend/src/handlers/*.ts.
test_framework: Vitest everywhere. Backend: unit {source}.test.ts + property {source}.property.test.ts (fast-check, numRuns 100), integration in backend/src/__tests__/integration (LocalStack, not run here). Frontend: Vitest + React Testing Library + fast-check + vitest-axe (every component test asserts expect(container).toHaveNoViolations()). Infra: Vitest snapshot/assertion tests in infra/test.
build_command: Backend: cd <WT>/backend && npx vitest --run. Frontend: cd <WT>/frontend && npx vitest --run. Infra: cd <WT>/infra && npx cdk diff --all (synth/diff ONLY).
test_command: cd <WT>/backend && npm install (first time) && npx vitest --run ; cd <WT>/frontend && npm install (first time) && npx vitest --run ; cd <WT>/infra && npm install (first time) && npx vitest --run && npx cdk diff --all
verification_instructions: After each FEAT, run vitest --run in every affected package and ensure green. For infra changes also run npx cdk diff --all and confirm synth succeeds (NEVER cdk deploy). Infra snapshot tests (infra/test/__snapshots__) will change when routes/GSI are added — regenerate intentionally and confirm the diff is limited to the intended additions. Do NOT push and do NOT open a PR.
snapshot_or_generated_files: infra/test/__snapshots__/foundation-stack.test.ts.snap and infra/test/__snapshots__/api-stack.test.ts.snap are checked-in CDK snapshots. Adding GSI3 and new routes/Lambdas changes them; regenerate by running npx vitest --run in infra (vitest updates snapshots per its config; if not auto, run npx vitest --run -u) and verify only intended changes appear.

contribution_requirements: Strict Handler -> Service -> Repository layering (handlers NEVER call repositories directly; services call repositories). AppError factories only (never raw throw). All responses via successResponse/errorResponse. JSDoc with 'METHOD /path' above each handler. Named exports only (no default exports). kebab-case filenames, one handler per file, one service per domain. ESM .js import extensions. Property tests (fast-check, numRuns 100, describe block referencing feature name + property number, test docstring referencing the validated requirement) REQUIRED for: session-ownership on create, within-team displayName uniqueness, team-scoped list filtering, delete order+idempotency, quota-exceeded. Frontend components keep vitest-axe toHaveNoViolations. UI text Japanese; code/comments English; API error messages English (frontend converts to Japanese). Spec/requirements in Japanese.
key_patterns: auth-middleware.js: extractUser, requireRole(user,'TEAM_LEADER'|'ADMIN'), isAdmin, denyResourceAccess (throws 404 to hide existence). access-control-service.js: getUserTeamIds, isTeamMember, checkSessionAccess, requireTeamAccess. team-repository.js: getTeamById, getTeamsByUserId, getAllTeams. audit-service.js: recordAuditLog({actorUserId,actorRole,operationType,resourceId,resourceType,metadata}). dynamodb-client.js: docClient (removeUndefinedValues:true) + TABLE_NAME. error-handler.js: notFoundError/validationError/forbiddenError/internalError (add quotaExceededError 429). Rename reference: handlers/patch-session-name.ts + session-service.renameSession (trim, 1-100). Infra: createLambda(name,{entry,description,environment,fileName?,exportedHandler?}) + per-fn grantDynamoDbRead/grantDynamoDbReadWrite/grantS3ReadWrite/grantKmsAccess + role.addToPolicy for Transcribe/S3, then addRoute(method,path,fn,jwtAuthorizer). Frontend api-client: get/post/patch/delete -> Result<T,AppError>; inline-edit UX ref components/SessionNameEditor.tsx.
gsi_decision: Only GSI1 and GSI2 exist today (projectionType ALL). GSI3 must be ADDED new (GSI3PK fixed 'LANGUAGEMODEL', GSI3SK=modelName). GSI1 ride-on SAFE: GSI1PK=TEAM#{teamId} already shared by MediaFile (GSI1SK=MEDIA#...) and ReviewSession (GSI1SK=SESSION#...); LanguageModel uses GSI1SK=LANGUAGEMODEL#{modelName}, a distinct begins_with prefix, invisible to existing queries. GSI2 ride-on SAFE: existing GSI2PK are USER#/OPERATION#/TRANSCRIBE#; LanguageModel uses GSI2PK=TEAM#{teamId}#DISPLAYNAME, an unused partition. Verify non-collision at test level; if any begins_with assumption is violated, switch to dedicated GSIs and note the deviation.
